project_context: Portal Restyle: Migrate CRA portal to public-site cream/ink design system
theme_strategy: a2 (Public-site base + reserved portal accent). The portal is light-themed (cream/ink).

fonts.recommendation: Match public site exactly for a unified client journey.
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono (Labels, kickers, data points, status pills)

colors.rationale: Cream is the primary background. Cards use white for elevation without heavy shadows. Accent is a Deep Cyan (#0E7490), an accessible, light-theme homage to the portal's original vivid cyan, reserved strictly for active navigational states, primary actions, and focus rings.

AuthPage.layout: Split hero layout. Left side: robust object-cover hero image (no placeholder). Right side: login/signup form on Cream background.
AuthPage.typography: Space Grotesk for 'Welcome back', JetBrains Mono for form labels.
AuthPage.interactions: Use a subtle Reveal on form load.

Layout.nav_links: Inactive: text-ink/60 hover:bg-sand hover:text-ink. Active: bg-ink text-cream font-medium
Layout.admin_links: Keep separate but use sand/dune backgrounds rather than glaring warning colors.
Layout.user_profile: Bottom section border-t border-dune. Name in ink, role in ink/50 mono.

shared_components.Input: bg-white border border-dune text-ink placeholder-ink/40 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:border-transparent outline-none
shared_components.Label: font-mono text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-ink/60 mb-1.5
shared_components.PageHeader: title in font-display text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink, kicker in font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-accent
shared_components.StatusPill: font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border
shared_components.Empty: bg-sand border border-dashed border-dune p-12 text-center text-ink/60 rounded-xl

index_css.animations: Update .card-hover to a subtle -translate-y-1 and shadow-md instead of a glow. Keep .rise (fade-up).

per_page_notes.Dashboard: Clean up stats grid. Apply staggered Reveal to cards. Recent deliverables list should have white background, dune borders, and distinct hover states (bg-sand).
per_page_notes.DeliverableDetail: The 'heavy' page. Maintain high contrast for the video player container. Review threads should use white message bubbles on cream background, bordered by dune. Revisions pills must stand out.
per_page_notes.Tables_Bookings_Retainers_Invoices: Use dense data views. border-collapse with border-b border-dune. Headers (th) should be font-mono text-[11px] text-ink/50 uppercase. Avoid glassmorphism here for maximum readability.
per_page_notes.Admin: Denser tables. Differentiate internal controls using slightly more prominent button outlines or secondary backgrounds.
per_page_notes.Profile: Form fields neatly stacked in a max-w-md white card centered on a cream page.

micro_interactions.Reveal: Apply to Dashboard card grids, table rows (staggered entry), and PageHeaders. Excellent translation from public site.
micro_interactions.Marquee: Omit. Fits marketing, not utilitarian dashboards.
micro_interactions.Glass-card: Omit for data-dense tables/dashboards. Can be used strictly for floating notifications (toasts) or modal overlays.
micro_interactions.Hover_states: Move away from color-shifting glows to physical elevation (shadow lifts, subtle bg shifts like white -> sand).

testing.attributes: Maintain and enhance data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) using kebab-case role-based naming.
